socket_path.description: Path to the Unix socket file used for sending commands to the Shepherd service manager.

config_file_path.description: Path to the main configuration file containing service definitions and setup scripts.

logfile_path.description: Path to the file where Shepherd logs its actions and status changes.

pidfile_path.description: Path to the file where the PID of the running Shepherd process is written.

syslog_enabled.description: Whether to log to the system syslog facility instead of or in addition to the logfile.

syslog_socket_path.description: Path to the syslog socket/device when syslog logging is enabled.

insecure_mode.description: If true, Shepherd will not ensure that the setup is secure (e.g., permission checks on config files).

silent_mode.description: If true, Shepherd will not produce output to stdout.
